name: skill-create
description: Scaffolds a new skill folder that already conforms to SKILL_FRAMEWORK.md, from a declared set of metadata.
inputs: The required skill.json metadata fields per SKILL_FRAMEWORK.md (name, version, category, layer, rank, description, inputs, outputs, dependencies, stack, runtime-independent, logging), gathered conversationally by Cowork before this skill's logic file runs.
outputs: A new skill folder under /skills/<name>/ containing skill.json, the correct logic file for the declared stack (or none, for an instruction-only skill), README.md, SECURITY.md, test.py, and SKILL.md -- written to the local filesystem, protocol: direct file output.
dependencies: PyYAML (test-time, and for SKILL.md frontmatter forms beyond single-line plain/quoted scalars; pinned in the repo's requirements.txt; main.py's --audit parses single-line plain, single-quoted and double-quoted scalars with a stdlib fallback without it)
runtime-independent-rationale: skill-create's output is a scaffolded skill folder on disk -- once main.py finishes running, the resulting files exist and are usable independent of any further AI involvement, same as any other craft/meta skill's generated artifact.
